0022600211.text: The Bucks (1-9, 15th in the East) visit the Knicks (5-4, fifth in the East) on a six-game losing streak, with Milwaukee 0-4 on the road and six games back in the Central, while New York has won three straight and sits three games back in the Atlantic. Tyler Herro is out for Milwaukee with a knee bruise after averaging 21.4 points in 30.7 minutes per game this season, and Josh Hart is out for New York with an illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 127-98 defeat to New York in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
